The **ViSTA** paper, which explores a new method for understanding clinical time-series data, saw a significant jump in downloads.  The paper's authors claim their method can predict clinical time-series data with a 90% accuracy rate.  The paper's authors also claim that their method can be used to predict clinical time-series data with a 68% accuracy rate.  The paper's authors also claim that their method can be used to predict clinical time-series data with a 5.2 billion accuracy rate.
